The average Kinrath. Of a light yellow-brownish color, but other varieties show different markings and come in colors as diverse as orange and green. Kinrath seem to be hive creatures, and a single female kinrath matriarch is the leader of a hive. Kinrath have four legs and a leg-like, poisonous appendage coming out of their faces that they used to attack prey or other perceived enemies. All kinrath are blind but can sense heat which allows them to navigate their way around and identify potential threats, and makes them effective ambush hunters. They identify members of their own hive using a specialized sweat gland in the abdomen which excreted a specific scent.

Kath hounds are about the size of a large dog, fur-covered, and each limb ends in four hoofed digits. They are generally not very hostile, unless provoked, but if they are their massive maw is enough to remove limbs. Though native to Dantooine, Viscara appears to have a considerable wild hound population. Invasive as they are, their numbers grow steadily as Warocas numbers dwindle.

The Gimpassa is a tortoise-like creature native to Viscara. It is incredibly durable, and surprisingly aggressive. It protects the waters it feeds in with lethal fervor, moving surprisingly quickly and headbutting its target hard enough to shatter bones. It also has a set of sharp, thin teeth capable of piercing thick armour.

Every station has its own smell.  This one... isn't one of of the more fragrant stations you've been on.

Something might be awry with the purifiers; you can definitely smell sweat, smoke and something else out of place.  Someone has attempted to mask it by throwing a strong floral scent, but the overall effect is not appealing.

Happily, as ever with new smells, within minutes you've acclimitised to it and no longer notice it.  Phew.
